pages.title: Cave Wolf
pages.text: The cave wolf ($(o)Canis lupus spelaeus$()) is an extinct subspecies of the gray wolf that lived in Europe during the Late Pleistocene.$(br2)It takes its name from the caves in which many of its remains have been found.$(br2)Like other Ice Age wolves, it had a sturdier skull and stronger teeth than most living wolves, suited to hunting and scavenging the large animals of the mammoth steppe.
